strings: Early-round Grounds Admission is your strongest match for discovering a wide variety of tennis across the outside courts at an affordable cost. While your preferred later rounds fall outside your selected travel date, the opening rounds offer more opportunities to explore different matches. Outside-court seating is generally unreserved and subject to availability, rather than providing a designated stadium seat.

Louis Armstrong Courtside offers reserved seating close to the action in a larger show-court setting. Compared with Grounds Admission, it costs more and shifts your experience from daytime court exploration to a dedicated night session. Consider it if courtside viewing and evening atmosphere appeal more than discovering matches across the grounds.

Grandstand Courtside offers a more intimate stadium experience with reserved seating close to the action. It costs more than Grounds Admission and provides less flexibility for exploring multiple outside courts, but retains the daytime experience. Choose Grandstand if having a reserved courtside seat matters more than the freedom to move between matches.

Louis Armstrong Loge is your leading match for a daytime visit, combining reserved seating with an elevated view of the court and a lively show-court atmosphere. Compared with Grounds Admission, it offers the certainty of a reserved seat for the stadium session rather than unreserved seating at the outside courts. It's an attractive choice if you prefer a dedicated stadium seat while still enjoying the wider tournament atmosphere.

Grounds Admission offers greater flexibility to explore tennis across the outside courts at a lower cost. Unlike Louis Armstrong Loge, outside-court seating is generally unreserved and subject to availability. Choose this if discovering different matches matters more than having a reserved stadium seat.

Grandstand Courtside combines reserved seating with a closer, more intimate tennis-viewing experience than Louis Armstrong Loge. It places greater emphasis on proximity to the action rather than the atmosphere of a larger show court. Consider Grandstand if watching tennis up close is more important than the scale of the stadium.

Arthur Ashe Promenade is your strongest match for experiencing the US Open's iconic main stadium under the lights. It delivers the big-stadium atmosphere and night session you prefer, at a lower cost than the closer seating tiers. The trade-off is a more distant view of the court compared with Loge or Courtside.

Arthur Ashe Loge offers the same night-session atmosphere from a closer, more balanced viewing position. It costs more than Promenade but provides a clearer perspective on the rallies without the full Courtside premium. Consider Loge if court visibility matters as much as the stadium atmosphere.

Arthur Ashe Courtside brings you closest to the action while preserving the same stadium, tournament stage and night session. It is the most expensive of the three options, with the additional cost primarily reflecting proximity to the court. Courtside is worth considering if you want a more immersive, close-up experience.
